CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.

3. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

6. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

9. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

12. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
